description: Industrial pressures - Wastewater discharges is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Georeferenced information on more than 200 sites and 300 industrial effluents. It contains data calculated on an annual basis concerning the compliance and characteristics of wastewater discharges for mines, oil refineries, technical and pulp and paper landfills, pulp and paper mills, cement, lime and pelletizing plants, cement, lime and pelletizing plants, and other industries subject ... The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Pelletizing, Chaux, Cement plant, Compliance, Wastewater. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, HTML, PDF. The portal shows 2026-05-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
